finding: Invoice BL-2026-1187 shows a price discrepancy compared to purchase order PO-2026-0004. The invoice charges a unit price and net total of 380.00 EUR for 'Expresszustellung Ersatzteile', whereas purchase order PO-2026-0004 specifies a unit price and net total of 320.00 EUR (goods receipt WE-2026-0003 confirmed 1 unit received). The accounts-payable reviewer should contact the supplier to request a corrected invoice reflecting the agreed purchase order amount of 320.00 EUR net, or obtain internal authorization if the price increase was pre-approved.
email_body:

Bitte prüfen Sie den Vorgang und senden Sie uns eine korrigierte Rechnung oder eine entsprechende Gutschrift zu.
